text-13.e7dbceaa3074bc968ea4ec439fcfb602ec878978: Enter your support Tatari’s stars, evolution tier and food level to estimate its support bonus.

text-6.3aeea7b800774294f93e86233b08089f1af374a0: Your Luck Level combines your rod level and active bait bonuses. Higher luck changes both rarity chances and weight-tier chances. It does not identify which fish will appear next.

text-17.5c3b23c969fcb41ab5ef3b251c2f684ff502667e: Choose a difficulty to view its Zobo lineup and stat multipliers.

text-18.71c2389846b6ea106fc6dc612fa1d307b8e74b1a: Summons and enemies that escape can affect what happens during battle. ATK / DEF / HP values are wave multipliers, not a boss’s final stats.

note-1.a203d73796dbea66485da4dc657313a1df74c237: Season 3 reference: Each difficulty has 25 waves. Browse the enemies and stat multipliers below. Lineups may change with future updates.

note-4.300f89512bfc2d718f3973785935ba8adb20a3b0: Parting Gift adds its own refund. The chip describes +40 Energy Candy when one of your Tatari is knocked down. The base refund changes with the Tatari’s Horde level: 40 / 40 / 60 / 60 / 80 / 80 / 100 / 100 by level, rather than a universal +100 at every level.

text-32.10dbf16406d4d02332358a3f18f003e725e66e8f: Sandy Maze Mirages appear on Days 1, 3 and 5. Leagues compete by total kills in each Mirage; the league in first place when the countdown ends earns the points. Mirage locations can vary, so check the active sites in your event.

note-18.afb636c0927064fbad784356a9bacf661e3cef05: Mirage rewards are League Points. The league with the most kills when the countdown ends receives the objective’s league-point reward. These points count toward league rankings.
